scientific.integrity: The ordered-sequence classification is proved directly; finite exhaustive checks were used only to test the formulas and edge cases. Novelty is supported by targeted database and literature comparisons, with residual risk from unindexed literature explicitly retained.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to ordinary closed-neighborhood Grundy domination on connected complete multipartite graphs.
The finite checker is corroboration only; the infinite statement rests on the elementary structural proof.

title: Maximum Grundy dominating sequences of complete multipartite graphs
